notes: UCSD major code AT27. Total ~104 units (56 lower-division + 48 upper-division). C- or better in every course applied to the major; 2.0 GPA in upper-division major courses; at least 60% of upper-division major courses in residence at UCSD. Fewer required core courses and a larger elective breadth block than the Astronomy and Astrophysics B.S. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/ASTR-ug.html and astro.ucsd.edu majors-minor page. ASTR 18 is recommended (not required) for PHYS 2 track students. ASTR 199/199H may count as one elective.

buckets.label: Introductory Physics sequence
buckets.note: Complete EITHER the full PHYS 2A-B-C-D sequence (4 courses) OR the full PHYS 4A-B-C-D-E sequence (5 courses). needed=4 reflects the shorter PHYS 2 track; the PHYS 4 track requires all five. ASTR 18 is recommended (not required) for PHYS 2 track students.

buckets.label: Programming course (one from list)
buckets.note: Choose one programming course from this list. Verified verbatim against catalog.

buckets.label: Mathematics: linear algebra and calculus sequence
buckets.note: All six required: MATH 18 plus the MATH 20A-B-C-D-E sequence.

buckets.label: Introductory Astronomy & Astrophysics
buckets.note: Both required. ASTR 18 is recommended if taking the PHYS 2 series.

buckets.label: Upper-division core (three from list)
buckets.note: Choose three of these four. No separate ASTR 101-106 core requirement for this major. Verified verbatim against catalog.

buckets.label: Practical skills / lab (one from list)
buckets.note: One practical-skills (lab) course required from this list. Verified verbatim against catalog.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives (breadth)
buckets.note: Eight upper-division courses of at least 4 units each. Must include at least FOUR ASTR courses and at least THREE courses from other departments. The catalog lists the eligible external departments as: Physics (PHYS), Scripps/SIO, MAE, ECE, Mathematics (MATH), Data Science (DSC), Chemistry (CHEM), or Biology. The Biology subject ranges (BILD/BIBC/BICD/BIEB/BIPN) are the standard UCSD Biological Sciences subject codes expanded from the catalog's generic 'Biology'; the audit engine should verify exact eligible biology subjects with the department. ASTR 199/199H may count as one elective.
